title: Dual-Mode UI Serving & Zero-Build SPA Fallback

claims.assertion: The UI server checks for the existence of frontend/dist/index.html and automatically routes static assets to the compiled bundle.
If frontend/dist does not exist, the server serves the embedded single-file vanilla SPA without raising FileNotFoundError.
Tests verify REST endpoints and WebSockets operate consistently under both zero-build and React production modes.

context: Knowledge item ki_self_20260828_05: Dual-Mode UI Serving & Zero-Build SPA Fallback
distilled_learning:
### Distilled Heuristic
Web dashboard servers in developer tooling must support dual-mode static asset serving: auto-detecting and mounting modern compiled SPAs (e.g. React 19 / Vite in `frontend/dist`) while guaranteeing a zero-dependency, zero-build fallback (`static/index.html`) so headless and minimal environments never break.
